description: Source code for the SqlExecutionResultsCommand class in the Superset project, handling retrieval and validation of SQL query results from backend storage.

classes.name: SqlExecutionResultsCommand
classes.description: Handles validation and retrieval of SQL query results from the backend storage, including error handling and result deserialization.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the command with a results key and optional row limit.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the existence of the results backend, the query in the database, and the presence of results in the backend storage.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Performs the retrieval, decompression, deserialization, and optional row limiting of query results.
